agreement.note: pairs are restricted to |dT| <= 10 K so the comparison is not a temperature artifact

bootstrap.caveat: resampling 3-4 studies gives an interval that is itself unreliable; with fewer than 3 the interval is not estimable at all.

separation.source_ood: held-out measurement programme, molecules may still appear in training via other studies
separation.strict_source_ood: held-out programme AND its molecules removed from training
separation.warning: these three must never be pooled into one 'generalisation' number
